title: OriginPoint
description: The zone marking where a market maker's leftover position from a confirmed Liquidity Sweep is presumed established. See Detection_Methods/Origin_Point_Detection.md.

tier.description: LOWER_TIMEFRAME (e.g. 15m->5m drill-down) is entry-tied. HIGHER_TIMEFRAME (e.g. 4H->1H) is context/bias-tied, not a direct entry trigger. See Origin_Point_Detection.md's Origin Point Tiers section.

lower_bound.description: Default convention: origin candle's low (full range, not body). See Origin_Point_Detection.md's Zone Boundaries section — this is a flagged default pending confirmation.

source_candle_start.description: UTC open time of the origin candle.

timeframe.description: Timeframe the origin candle was identified on — may differ from the associated sweep's reference_timeframe.

detection_method.description: Which qualifying-impulse rule fired: gap_based (primary, via Inefficiency) or displacement_based (fallback, via swing_threshold).

confirmation_state.description: Three-value state, distinct from ReferenceLevel's two-value CONFIRMED/PROVISIONAL. INVALIDATED is distinct from Mitigation's MITIGATED — see Origin_Point_Detection.md's Invalidation Rule.

associated_sweep_id.description: Links back to the Liquidity Sweep instance that produced this origin_point.

mitigation_state.description: Tracked by Mitigation, referenced here for convenience; Mitigation is the source of truth.

approach_depth.description: AKA fill_ratio, mirrored here for convenience from MitigationState (that object is the source of truth). Entry threshold is zone-width dependent: 0.25 for a single-candle zone, 0.50 for a widened block — see Mitigation.md Calibration Evidence, not a fixed 0.75/0.50 tier.

observability.description: The zone/candle itself is CALCULATED; its meaning as a leftover position is INFERRED.
